coverage.scope: Named keyed lockboxes in the historical index plus official releases through Wild Adventures Lockbox (2026-09-01). Related recurring/event containers are listed separately.
coverage.contents_limit: Most rows have confirmed headliner rewards only. The detailed outcome groups are copied from the cited wiki pages where available; the file does not claim every possible item inside every reward pack.
coverage.icon_limit: Box icons are local copies in images/lockboxes/ (64px WebP; Runic 128px), sourced from the Neverwinter Wiki item pages and NW Hub. Buried Treasure and Wild Adventures have no published icon yet and need an in-game screenshot.
coverage.drop_rate_limit: Dragon Cult odds are transcribed from its chance table. A few pre-2022 rates are historical community estimates, not official odds. Later lockboxes display odds in-game, but most exact values were not transcribed.
coverage.platform_limit: Historical dates are PC dates from the index. Console release timing differed for older boxes.
